title: NFL combine's QB session showcased a big arm, a staggering athlete and plenty of developmental hope

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL combine's QB session showcased a big arm, a staggering athlete and plenty of developmental hope
sources.description: You can find some tools or traits to like, but when you get beyond Mendoza, the 2026 NFL Draft is filled with a litany of backup quarterbacks and a precious few who might develop into starters.
